dict.string: Daily encrypted Postgres dump. Streams pg_dump -Fc | rclone rcat to b2crypt:.../postgres/neondb-TS.dump (no plaintext at rest). Closes the Neon-not-pg_dumped gap from STORAGE_INVENTORY_2026-05-25.md. 03:30 local — 30 min after b2_backup at 03:00 to avoid bandwidth contention. RunAtLoad TRUE since 2026-08-20: catches storm-power / reboot scenarios where 03:30 fires during loginwindow-gap (Mac user LaunchAgents don't load until user login, silently skipping StartCalendarInterval). Wrapper has idempotency guard — if today's dump already exists in pinned bucket, skips work + exits 0.
